# Mukesh Saree Centre

> Mukesh Saree Centre is a saree and ethnic wear retailer and wholesaler based in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India, established in 1978. We sell sarees, co-ord sets, lehengas, kurtas, and uniform sarees (school, corporate, hospital) both online and in-store, with Cash on Delivery available across India.
